bills.title: Foreign Investment Reform (Protecting Australia’s National Security) Bill 2020

name: The majority voted in favour of a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/debate/?id=2020-12-07.137.1) to keep the question unchanged. In parliamentary jargon, they voted "*that the words proposed to be omitted stand part of the question.*" The question was: "That this bill be now read a [second time](https://peo.gov.au/understand-our-parliament/how-parliament-works/bills-and-laws/making-a-law-in-the-australian-parliament/)." To read a bill for a second time is to agree with its main idea.
